text: Cooking is the skillful preparation of food by applying heat, usually in a kitchen setting. The primary objective is to transform raw ingredients into nourishing and delicious dishes. Onions are the foundational ingredient in countless dishes, adding a robust base of umami and enhancing flavors through their complex tastes and aromas. Once chopped or sliced, they become a vital player in cooking, contributing to depth and balance. Garlic, though often introduced later into the cooking process, follows the onion’s lead by adding its own distinctive and pungent notes, transforming simple ingredients into a culinary centerpiece. Together, onions and garlic form the backbone of many classic and modern dishes, their aromatic contributions elevating simple recipes to memorable experiences.
